name: Shoujo Ganbou 2 ~Otome wa Higyaku ni Odoru~
original_name: 少女願望2 ～乙女は被虐に踊る～
source:
He took a liking to her petite girlish body.
When he could no longer hold back, he indulged in her.
Using her to gain access to her school, he made
other girls also succumb to carnal pleasures.
